en_title: Sony Announces $350 All-Black PS5, but You Probably Can't Buy It
cn_title: 索尼全黑PS5公布，多数玩家买不到
subtitle: 低价限定日本
opus_summary: 索尼公布日本限定「午夜黑」数字版PS5，11月19日与《GTA6》同日发售。该机仅支持系统语言为日语、国家或地区为日本的PlayStation账号。

paragraphs.en: After a few price increases, the PS5 will now set you back $599 for the digital edition, but Sony has just announced a cheaper $350 console – but it's exclusive to Japan.
paragraphs.cn: 经过几轮涨价，PS5数字版如今要花599美元(约合人民币4013元)才能买到。不过，索尼刚刚公布了一款更便宜的主机，售价350美元(约合人民币2345元)——但仅限日本市场。

paragraphs.en: In a blog post , Sony announced that it was launching a Japan-only digital 'Midnight Black' PS5 for 55,000 Yen, or approximately $350, on November 19, the same day as Grand Theft Auto 6 . At this point, with hardware prices being what they are, launching an affordable console like this worldwide might genuinely break sales records. However, the console will only be available in Japan.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼在一篇博客文章中宣布，日本限定「午夜黑」数字版PS5将于11月19日发售，与《侠盗猎车手》系列新作《GTA6》同日上市。主机售价为55,000日元(约合人民币2327元)，约为350美元(约合人民币2345元)。如今硬件价格居高不下，若在全球推出这样一款价格亲民的主机，或许真能打破销售纪录。然而，这款主机只会在日本销售。

paragraphs.en: According to Sony, this model can "only be used with a PlayStation account that has the system language set to 'Japanese' and the 'Country/Region' set to 'Japan.'" While there might be a way to game the system if you're really committed to it, for most people, this version of the PS5 is effectively exclusive to Japanese users.
paragraphs.cn: 索尼表示，这款机型「只能使用系统语言设为日语、国家／地区设为日本的PlayStation账号」。如果你铁了心要用，或许能找到绕过限制的办法，但对大多数人而言，这个版本的PS5实际上仅限日本用户使用。

paragraphs.en: This isn't the first time Sony has released a cheaper PS5 for the Japanese market. Back in November 2025, Sony announced a digital PS5 at the same 55,000 Yen price that was similarly exclusive to Japanese users, according to Polygon . However, a lot has changed in the year since then, and it's not just the fancy new colorway.
paragraphs.cn: 这并不是索尼首次为日本市场推出更便宜的PS5。据Polygon报道，早在2025年11月，索尼就公布过一款数字版PS5，售价同样为55,000日元(约合人民币2327元)，也仅限日本用户使用。不过，此后一年间发生了许多变化，变化可不只是这款亮眼的新配色。

paragraphs.en: Pretty much the entirety of 2026 has been marred by price increases at the hands of AI datacenters. This RAMageddon isn't going to let up any time soon , and has already caused Sony to raise the price of the PS5 and PS5 Pro here in the US back in March . And, now that used PS5 Pros are going for around $1,400 , there's likely another price increase around the corner.
paragraphs.cn: 几乎整个2026年，AI数据中心引发的涨价潮都挥之不去。这场「内存末日」短期内不会缓解，索尼已经因此在3月上调了美国市场的PS5和PS5 Pro售价。如今二手PS5 Pro的价格已达到约1,400美元(约合人民币9380元)，下一轮涨价很可能也不远了。

paragraphs.en: So, it's unlikely that Sony is going to announce a similarly-priced PS5 here in the US or in Europe any time soon. However, that 'Midnight Black' colorway doesn't exist here, with the closest version being the Black PS5 sold by Gamestop. But this new, slightly-different colorway is exclusive to Japan, and I'd love to see it released over in the US, even if it carries the same price as any other PS5.
paragraphs.cn: 因此，索尼短期内不太可能在美国或欧洲公布价格相近的PS5。不过，美国市场还没有「午夜黑」配色，最接近的是GameStop销售的黑色PS5。这款略有不同的新配色却仅限日本市场，我很希望它也能在美国推出，哪怕售价与其他PS5一样。
